description: This file defines a SigIntWatcher class for handling SIGINT signals, including managing duplicate signals from npm/npx, with internal class FixedNodeSIGINTHandler for signal handling logic.

classes.name: SigIntWatcher
classes.description: A class to watch for SIGINT signals and handle them asynchronously.

classes.name: FixedNodeSIGINTHandler
classes.description: A class managing SIGINT signal handlers, including ignoring duplicate signals and installing/uninstalling handlers.

methods.name: promise
methods.description: Returns a promise that resolves when a SIGINT signal is received.

methods.name: hadSignal
methods.description: Returns whether a SIGINT signal has been received.

methods.name: _dispatch
methods.description: Dispatches SIGINT signals to registered handlers, managing duplicate signals with a timeout.

methods.name: _install
methods.description: Installs the SIGINT handler if not already installed.

methods.name: _uninstall
methods.description: Removes the SIGINT handler if installed.

methods.name: on
methods.description: Registers a handler for SIGINT signals.

methods.name: off
methods.description: Unregisters a handler for SIGINT signals.
